title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the quiet upper floors of the Richardson Library to the light-filled atriums of the Loop, DePaul offers diverse environments for deep focus and collaborative work.

cards.title: O'Neil Reading Room
cards.subtitle: John T. Richardson Library, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Work in a traditional academic environment designed for individual quiet study and research focus.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study space on the third floor of the John T. Richardson Library in Lincoln Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Neil Reading Room on the 3rd floor of Richardson Library is designed for individual work and quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; third and fourth floors are designated quiet zones.

cards.title: Loop Library Solo Booths
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, 10th Floor
cards.notes: Reserve a sound-insulated booth for private video calls, online exams, or distraction-free focus.
cards.short_summary: Sound-insulated individual booths available for reservation at the Loop Campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Loop Library has two solo booths that can be booked for 30-minute slots, up to two hours.
cards.source_title: Search Spaces - Loop Library - DePaul University Library Calendar
cards.access_notes: Reservable by current students; limited to one reservation per day.

cards.title: Arts & Letters Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: 2315 N. Kenmore Ave
cards.notes: Study in light-filled bays overlooking a four-story atrium with views of the city skyline.
cards.short_summary: Modern lounge and study areas located on each floor of the Arts & Letters Hall in Lincoln Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts & Letters Hall features lounge and study areas on each of its floors and an interior staircase overlooking a four-story atrium.
cards.source_title: Arts & Letters Hall | Buildings | Campus Maps
cards.access_notes: Public lounge areas available during building operating hours.

cards.title: The Pit
cards.subtitle: Schmitt Academic Center (SAC)
cards.notes: Find a table or couch in this central sunken lounge, located near The Bean coffee shop.
cards.short_summary: A popular central lounge area in the Schmitt Academic Center with tables and printing access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pit is in the center of the SAC building and features tables, couches, and access to a printer.
cards.source_title: 10 Locations to Study on Campus | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Open during SAC building hours; can be active and social.

cards.title: Commuter Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, 11th Floor
cards.notes: Relax or study in a dedicated space for commuters, featuring comfortable seating and kitchen amenities.
cards.short_summary: A specialized lounge for commuter students located on the top floor of the DePaul Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commuter Student Lounge is located on the 11th Floor (11027) of the DePaul Center.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to DePaul students; check for specific commuter-focused hours.

cards.title: McGowan South Glass Bridge
cards.subtitle: McGowan South to McGowan North
cards.notes: Utilize the seating along the glass-walled bridge for a bright environment between science labs.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit connecting bridge with seating areas between the McGowan science buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The glass bridge connects McGowan South and McGowan North and provides a space with natural light.
cards.source_title: My favourite on-campus spots to study: Winter edition | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; typically quieter in the late afternoon.

cards.title: Jarvis Student Center
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, Lower Level
cards.notes: Collaborate in an 8,000 square-foot open space designed for multidisciplinary projects and emerging tech.
cards.short_summary: An innovative, open-plan collaboration space for students in the Loop Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jarvis Student Center for Innovation and Collaboration is an 8,000 square-foot open space on the lower level of the DePaul Center.
cards.source_title: Labs & Facilities | Jarvis College of Computing and Digital Media
cards.access_notes: Primarily for CDM students but supports multidisciplinary community work.

cards.title: Demon Den
cards.subtitle: LPC Student Center, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study in a school-spirited lounge area featuring couches and comfortable chairs.
cards.short_summary: A Blue Demon-themed lounge area on the second floor of the Lincoln Park Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Demon Den is a small area on the second floor of the Student Center with couches and comfortable chairs for homework.
cards.source_title: 10 Locations to Study on Campus | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center hours; located near the dining hall.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: John T. Richardson Library, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Access high-end technology and collaborative work tables in this active learning environment.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich collaborative space on the first floor of the Richardson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Richardson Library Information Commons is designed for collaborative learning and open-plan use of technology.
cards.access_notes: First floor allows for group discussion and active engagement.

cards.title: Holtschneider Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: 2330 N. Halsted St
cards.notes: Find quiet corners in this state-of-the-art music facility, serving as the eastern gateway to campus.
cards.short_summary: Modern lounge and classroom spaces within the School of Music's flagship building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holtschneider Performance Center features three floors of performance, practice, and classroom space.
cards.source_title: Holtschneider Performance Center | School of Music
cards.access_notes: Open during School of Music hours; check for performance schedule disruptions.
